tiebreakers.description: Most rounds with zero or fewer proposals.
If still tied, everyone plays another random black-hourglass round; its winner need not be a previously tied player.

rounds.endCondition: Five rounds, then additional black-hourglass round if tiebreak remains.

notes: family: trick-taking-penalty. Base Princes score 1 each and Frog (Pets 8) scores 5. Round cards change scoring, so enter resolved round totals. Taking all Princes and Frog replaces that player’s entire round score with -10. Extra-round continuation requires manual play; schema cannot trigger it. Short three-round option excluded. Official English rulebook PDF is image-only; scoring, Rebel of the Ball, end of game and tiebreak were read visually from its pages 9-12 and cross-checked against the publisher page.
